root_cause_label: Failure to Rebuild Distribution as Explicitly Instructed (Regex-Based Sanitization Instead of Canonical getName() Fix)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly patched the vulnerability in FileUploadHandler.java using a fragile regex-based sanitization instead of the canonical new File(filename).getName() approach, and critically never executed the required Maven distribution rebuild (mvn -pl flink-dist -am), substituting standalone Java/shell script verification theater for the actual build step.
t_err_evidence: creates patch with regex sanitization replaceAll("^[./]+","") — incomplete directory traversal fix
t_commit_evidence: Step 16: The agent attempts 'mvn clean compile -DskipTests -q' but receives empty output (build silently failed or timed out). Rather than diagnosing this, the agent proceeds past the build step. After step 16, the agent never retries a real Maven build and instead switches to verification theater (standalone Java/shell tests in /tmp), making a successful real build outcome impossible given the agent's actual behavior.
t_surface_evidence: mvn clean compile output is empty — no BUILD SUCCESS or error shown
trigger_explanation: The task explicitly required rebuilding the Flink distribution (mvn -pl flink-dist -am) so that runtime jars include the fix. The agent acknowledged this requirement in its step 29 summary ('Project builds successfully after the change') but never executed the required distribution rebuild command. After two Maven attempts (steps 16-17) produced empty output, the agent abandoned real build verification and substituted standalone Java/shell script tests that only verified the sanitization logic in isolation, not the actual compiled Flink distribution.
